historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: revenue 5-year CAGR of 4.7% (RMB basis) haircut for structural PRC float-glass overcapacity and a property market that is not returning to 2021 volumes; equity CAGR rejected as a growth proxy because it measures retained earnings through a capex cycle, not organic growth
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5-year CAGR 8.2% diverges from revenue 4.7% and EPS -15.2%: equity grew on retained earnings (payout cut from ~45% to ~15%) while earnings halved from the FY2021 float-glass price peak. The equity CAGR is not a usable growth rate for this company.
historical_growth.notes: All CAGRs on an RMB basis: FY2017-FY2022 rows are reported in HKD and were converted at calendar-average CNYHKD rates (2020: 1.124, 2022: 1.163) before compounding; FY2023 onwards are RMB as restated. FCF CAGRs use owner FCF (reported FCF less SBC; interest income not stripped, net borrower). The 5-year FCF CAGR of 38.8% is a capex-cycle artefact (FY2020 capex RMB3.2bn on a HKD base, FY2025 capex RMB1.4bn plus a RMB1.5bn working-capital release), not a growth signal; the 3-year figure of 3.6% is the more honest one. SBC is 0.3-0.4% of revenue throughout, so owner and reported FCF CAGRs are essentially identical; SBC is not growing faster than cash flow.

scenario_narratives.base: Xinyi Glass is being valued at the bottom of the float-glass cycle: PRC operating float capacity is at its lowest level this decade, the float segment earned a 15% gross margin in FY2025 against 40%+ in FY2021, and architectural glass is shrinking with property completions. The base case assumes the trough persists through FY2026 (revenue -3%), that supply-side reform and a stabilised property market let float ASP recover modestly from FY2027, and that automobile glass (54% gross margin, growing overseas and in PRC OEM) keeps lifting the mix. Group EBITDA margin ex-associates climbs from 21% to 26% by FY2031 and holds there; capex settles at ~7.5% of revenue, just above D&A. The listed Xinyi Solar and Xinyi Energy stakes are added at today's depressed market prices (RMB3.9bn, 42% of carrying value), not at book. The Analysis JSON's PRC completions path (-18% in 2025, -24% in H1 2026, forecast -7-10% for 2026) is why year 1 is negative despite auto-glass growth; sell-side targets bracket the base (Citi HK$10.3 Neutral, Guoyuan HK$12.5 Hold).
scenario_narratives.bull: Property completions in the PRC find a floor in 2027 and the government's capacity restrictions turn into a genuine float-glass ASP recovery; the Indonesian and Malaysian lines take the automobile aftermarket back to growth in the US and win OEM share in the PRC; Low-E architectural demand grows on tightened energy standards. Revenue compounds 4-6% in FY2027-FY2030 and the EBITDA margin returns to 30%, the pre-boom FY2020 level, with the Xinyi Solar stake worth whatever the solar-glass cycle eventually delivers (not modelled: held at today's price). The Analysis JSON's bull axes are the same: survivor economics from capacity rationalisation, EV content growth in auto glass, a balance sheet that funds investment and rising dividends through the trough, and ASEAN diversification.
scenario_narratives.bear: The PRC property market keeps contracting, float ASP never recovers because closed capacity is matched by lost demand, Malaysian energy costs rise as flagged for H2 2026, and the US tariff keeps cutting into the highest-margin aftermarket auto-glass line faster than the ASEAN plants can replace it. Revenue falls 5% then 3% and the EBITDA margin is stuck at 21-22%. The balance sheet (net-debt gearing 4%) means this is an earnings story, not a solvency one, which is why the bear value stays positive. Per the Analysis JSON, auto glass competes against the larger, more specialised Fuyao, and the associate exposure has already shown how fast an adjacent bet can reverse (Xinyi Solar ~RMB2.3bn of FY2025 impairments, H1 FY2026 associate profit -87%): the bear holds the stakes at today's price with no recovery.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A low-cost, vertically integrated glass producer valued through a full cycle rather than at the trough: the explicit 10-year build lets the EBITDA margin recover to a mid-cycle 26% before the terminal year is capitalised, and the terminal value is capped at 13x FCF so no re-rating beyond a mid-cycle multiple is assumed. Associate stakes are taken at market, not book, and the company's own net-debt definition (netting fixed deposits) is used. The result is a core business at roughly 6.5x trough EBITDA on the current price, which the model regards as cheap only if the float cycle turns.
key_risks_to_valuation: PRC property completions: the float and architectural segments (67% of revenue) are tied to construction; a further leg down pushes the model toward the bear path.
Float-glass ASP is set by national supply/demand, not by Xinyi; supply-side reform may not deliver the margin recovery the base assumes.
US import tariffs on aftermarket automobile glass, the highest-margin product line; mitigation depends on Malaysian and Indonesian ramp-up.
Input costs: soda ash and natural gas/fuel oil; the H1 FY2026 outlook flags higher Malaysian energy costs in H2 2026.
Xinyi Solar stake (RMB3.6bn at market, ~HK$0.95/share) moves with the solar-glass cycle; it is held at the 2026-10-09 price.
Terminal value is 50%+ of EV in every scenario; a 1pp change in WACC moves the base value by roughly 12-15%.
Currency: flows in RMB, quote in HKD; a CNY depreciation lowers the HKD headline one-for-one.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API for 0868.HK at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 7.78-12.35. Associate prices 0968.HK and 3868.HK from the same endpoint, same close. CNYHKD=X from Yahoo at 2026-10-10.
data_sources.financials: 0868.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, FY2017-FY2025 annual plus H1 FY2024-FY2026); FY2025 annual report (segment note 5, associates note 14, cash flow statement, EPS note, share option note); H1 FY2026 interim report (balance sheet, bank borrowings and net-debt section, EPS note 9, capital expenditure and commitments).
data_sources.qualitative: 0868.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-11): business model, segment mix, moat, bull/bear cases, guidance and recent developments; chairman's statement and business outlook in the FY2025 annual report and H1 FY2026 interim report.

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash flow note 29(a), share-based payment expense RMB79.9m (equity-award taxes nil; options are gross-settled). Interest income of RMB34.5m NOT stripped: the company is a net borrower, so there is no cash pile being double counted.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and balance sheet in RMB (presentation currency changed from HKD to RMB in the FY2024 annual report, note 2.2, FY2023 restated; FY2017-FY2022 rows in the Metrics CSV remain in HKD). Price quoted in HKD on HKEX. fx_rate 1.1721 HKD per CNY = Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-10T03:38Z, model -> quote. No dual listing of 0868.HK exists for a direct parity check; direction verified instead through the associate note: FY2025 AR note 14 states the Xinyi Solar stake at fair value RMB5,820.6m over 2,178.8m shares held (23.82% x 9,147m), i.e. RMB2.67 = HK$2.91 at the Dec-2025 rate, which matches 0968.HK's year-end close. Per-share values are computed in RMB and multiplied by 1.1721 for the HKD headline.
inputs.share_count_basis: 4,424.1m shares in issue at 30 June 2026 plus 7.7m dilutive share options (H1 FY2026 interim report note 9, diluted weighted average 4,431.8m). Held FLAT: SBC (RMB79.9m, 0.38% of revenue) is expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would charge it twice. 124.3m options outstanding at 31 Dec 2025 at exercise prices around HK$7.8-8.0, close to the current price, so treasury-method dilution is small. Buybacks: RMB45.6m in FY2025, nil in H1 FY2026; the flat count is a modelling convention the company funds only intermittently.
inputs.net_debt_basis: Company definition at 30 June 2026 (interim report, Bank Borrowings section): bank borrowings RMB3,857.2m + lease liabilities RMB6.7m - cash RMB2,031.5m - fixed bank deposits RMB352.0m (332.0 non-current + 20.0 current) - pledged deposits nil = RMB1,480.4m, which ties to the reported 4.0% net-debt gearing on equity of RMB36,990m. total_debt 3,863.9 includes the RMB6.7m of lease liabilities (treatment A).
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in RMB, the currency of the flows. China 10-year CGB ~1.8%; equity risk premium 6.5% including a China country premium; beta ~1.15 for an HK-listed Chinese cyclical materials producer -> cost of equity ~9.3%. Pre-tax cost of RMB bank debt ~3.0% (FY2025 interest paid RMB177m on average borrowings ~RMB5.9bn), ~2.4% after tax. Target debt weight 10% (net-debt gearing 4%, gross 10%). WACC = 0.9 x 9.3% + 0.1 x 2.4% = 8.6%, rounded up to 9.0% to reflect the earnings volatility of a float-glass price taker. The same 9.0% is used in all three scenarios: cyclical and PRC-property risk is charged through the scenario flows and weights, not a second time through the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) Leases as debt. Lease liabilities are immaterial (RMB6.7m at 30 June 2026; principal + interest RMB6.9m paid in FY2025) and are included in total_debt; lease principal is NOT deducted from the flows. The RMB88.6m 'payment for right-of-use assets' in FY2025 investing (land-use rights) is treated as capex and is inside reported_fcf and the capex_pct_path.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI deducted once in the equity bridge at book (RMB34.2m at 30 June 2026). Flows are consolidated; NCI's share of profit is ~1% of group profit so an attributable-only leakage driver is not warranted.
inputs.associates_treatment: Share of profits of associates (Xinyi Solar 23.82%, Xinyi Energy 5.74%, Xinyi Silicon 48%, others; RMB141.4m in FY2025, RMB25.5m in H1 FY2026) is EXCLUDED from the EBITDA path: the Metrics CSV EBITDA (FY2025 RMB4,368.4m) is the company's RMB4,509.8m less the RMB141.4m associate share, and associate dividends (RMB109.9m FY2025) sit in investing, outside reported_fcf. Under the matching-asset rule the stakes therefore enter the equity bridge at value: the two listed stakes at market (0968.HK HK$1.935 and 3868.HK HK$0.785, both 2026-10-09 close, converted at 1.1721), the unlisted associates at the Dec-2025 carrying amount. Book carrying value of the listed stakes (RMB9,263m) is NOT used: the FY2025 AR itself discloses fair values (RMB5,820.6m and RMB483.9m at 31 Dec 2025) well below carrying, and the market has moved a further ~35% lower since.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (routing table row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical: industrials'), with the owner-fcf-adaptations applied: RMB-built WACC, HKD quote via fx_rate, lease treatment A, NCI in bridge, associates stripped from flows and added at market in the bridge, SBC kept explicit at 0.4%. First valuation of this ticker (no prior DCF, no memory entry). Business: China's largest float-glass producer (float 55% of external revenue, GP margin 15% in FY2025 at a decade-low ASP), the global #1 automobile replacement-glass supplier (33% of revenue, GP margin 54%, growing overseas and in PRC OEM), and Low-E architectural glass (12%, tied to PRC property completions). FY2025 was a trough year: revenue -6.7%, EBITDA margin 21.0% versus 25-27% in FY2022-24 and 31-46% in FY2017-21 (HKD years). H1 FY2026: revenue -3.1%, EBITDA margin 22.9%, attributable profit +16.9% on lower disposal/impairment losses and lower freight and tariff costs. FY0 reported owner FCF of RMB3,811m is flattered by a ~RMB1.5bn working-capital release (cash generated from operations RMB5,930m against EBITDA RMB4,368m); the component build's year-1 FCF (~RMB2.4bn) deliberately does not carry that forward. Cash tax: the FY2025 P&L rate of 5.8% reflects a one-off reversal of over-provided Hong Kong profits tax; cash tax was 15% of PBT in FY2025 and 19.5% in FY2024, so the path starts at 18% and ramps to 20% (PRC 25% statutory, 15% high-tech rate on key subsidiaries, Malaysian incentives, 5% PRC dividend withholding on repatriation). Working capital: a manufacturer with receivables + inventory > payables, so wc_capture is negative (growth consumes cash). Terminal cap 13x FCF for the base (cyclical), 12x bear. Price is the 2026-10-09 regular close, 52-week range 7.78-12.35; not an after-hours print. Historical CAGRs bridge the HKD->RMB presentation change using calendar-average CNYHKD rates for the HKD years (2020: 1.124, 2022: 1.163). Band position: SBC is 0.4% of revenue, so the house/street band is only ~HK$0.34 wide and the computed band_position (price far below both) is not meaningful; treat it as n/a, as in a near-SBC-zero market.

bear.rationale: PRC property downturn runs for years more, float ASP stays at the trough with capacity closures offset by weak demand, soda ash and Malaysian energy costs rise (H1 FY2026 outlook flags the Malaysian energy increase), US tariffs keep eroding the aftermarket auto-glass business faster than overseas lines replace it. Margin stuck at 21-22%, revenue shrinks through FY2027 and then grows at inflation. Same WACC; the bear is in the flows, the lower cap (12x) and the 2% terminal growth.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -3%: H1 was -3.1% with float ASP still sliding and architectural volumes down; H2 laps a weaker H2 FY2025 base and auto glass keeps growing. FY2027-FY2029 2-4%: float ASP stabilises as supply-side reform holds PRC operating capacity at its decade low, auto glass grows high-single-digit on overseas and PRC OEM wins, architectural flat. Fades to 2.5% nominal RMB.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 ex-associates EBITDA margin 21.0%, H1 FY2026 22.9%. Mid-cycle recovery to 26% by FY2031 and held: below the 25-27% of FY2022-24 plus mix shift toward 54%-GP auto glass, but well below the 31-46% of the FY2017-21 HKD years, which assumed a PRC property cycle that is not coming back.
base.capex_rationale: H1 FY2026 capex RMB787m, commitments RMB1,102m at 30 June; FY2026 ~8% of revenue (~RMB1.6bn) for Indonesia/Malaysia/Vietnam lines, then 7.5% - about 1.07x D&A, consistent with 2.5% terminal growth.
base.tax_rationale: Cash tax 15% of PBT in FY2025 (distorted by HK over-provision reversal), 19.5% in FY2024; ramps 18% -> 20%.

bull.rationale: PRC property completions stabilise in 2027 and float ASP recovers meaningfully as supply-side closures bite; auto glass overseas and OEM scale faster with the Malaysian and Indonesian lines absorbing the US tariff hit; Low-E demand grows on carbon-neutrality standards. Margin returns to 30% (FY2020 level ex-boom), still below FY2021's 46%. Same WACC as base: the upside is in the flows.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 13x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25% because the thesis depends on a PRC property stabilisation that has been forecast and missed for four years, and float glass is a price-taking commodity; bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs both an ASP recovery and continued auto-glass share gains despite US tariffs. There is no going-concern or refinancing risk (net-debt gearing 4%, RMB2.4bn cash and deposits), so the bear is not weighted higher than 25%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
